description: This Java source file defines the ValidateMethodCondition class, which implements a conditional operation for validating method calls within the Apache OFBiz mini-language framework. It handles the <if-validate-method> element, executing sub-operations based on the result of invoking a specified static method via reflection.

classes.name: ValidateMethodCondition
classes.description: Implements a conditional check that invokes a static method via reflection to determine if sub-operations should be executed.

classes.name: ValidateMethodConditionFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating instances of ValidateMethodCondition for the <if-validate-method> element.

methods.name: checkCondition
methods.description: Invokes the specified static method with a string parameter to evaluate the condition.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Executes sub-operations based on the result of checkCondition.

methods.name: prettyPrint
methods.description: Generates a human-readable representation of the condition.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the <if-validate-method> element.
